verdict.rationale: Bench offers client-facing reports: income statement, balance sheet, a P&L and Top Expenses dashboard, 1099 reports, and custom time-period views. None of the evidence shows custom report building, or filtering and grouping by class, location, or tag dimensions. Choosing a time period is a related control, not dimensional reporting, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions
